clean_html:
Lynn C. Jackson

Preserved Primary Document • jacklyn.htm

Congratulations !!!!! I don't know what route you took to reach this page but you have found the creator of this website. Unfortunately, there's no "PRIZE" but I hope you have found this site of interest and, possibly, of some use in your own genealogical ramblings. There are so many people whose information I have gratefully used. I have tried to thank them along the way but I apologize for any I have missed: to Maybelle Bordley, John Carter, Chuck Conceller, Wythena Muntz Fleming, Ned & Louise Heite, Lorraine Johnson-Gregg, Harry Muncey, Michelle Pierce, Rosemarie "Sweetsie" Ridgeway, Don Fisher, Joseph Romeo, Preston Sammons, Sterling Street, Betty & Ray Terry and Debbie Pierce Unger. There are many people who have contacted me as the result of finding these pages and it has been a thrill to meet my new-found "cousins". This site will never be "completed". There is always new information to be found and changes and corrections to be made to old info. I hope to be able to continue adding new information for many years to come. Thank You !!!!
